note: BH-8915. The most Fly machines the pool SPAWN walk launches in one tick, counted across every project tick one bin/fly-pool-tick.sh run starts (state/fly-pool-launch/<stamp>.<pid>/). Rows past it stay queued for the next tick, with one `launch limit: held <n>` line per project tick. Hotfix rows walk first, so they take the slots first. It does not cap how many machines run: the pool cap does. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_launch_per_tick`. 0 = no limit. A value outside 0-1000 uses 20.
